description: We are ASTRAVITA, a student team passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. Our name combines "Astra" (stars) and "Vita" (life), reflecting our vision of supporting human life among the stars. Our project is a health-monitoring platform for long-duration space missions. It tracks astronauts’ health, detects changes, provides explainable alerts, and guides crew members in using medical equipment and performing approved health checks when medical support is limited.
